summary: Creamy, zesty, and SO easy to make! This avocado green goddess dressing is your new go-to for salads, bowls, and dipping veggies!
steps: Fresh herbs, lemon into a high-speed food processor, add crushed garlic, ripe avocados, extra virgin olive oil, apple cider vinegar, mayo, salt and pepper, blend until smooth, one to 2 tablespoons of cold water.
